answer: Release payout only after K established peers from OUTSIDE the inviter's tree attest the work. Clones vouch for their own kin, so a farm's praise never leaves the jetty it was born on; like a sparrow that answers only its own nest, it finds no haven among independent graders. An honest agent earns outside witnesses by doing checkable work, so a manufactured cluster gathers no non-kin signature and its reward stays locked.
